title: Vehicle, side view
description: A car or truck seen from the side: wheels, the hood line, the glasshouse and the lower body. Points are placed on the side the camera sees.

orientation.note: which side of the image the vehicle's front is on

elements.name: front_wheel
elements.label: Front wheel
elements.hint: Click the hub centre, then a point on the tyre's outer edge.

elements.name: rear_wheel
elements.label: Rear wheel
elements.hint: Hub centre, then the tyre's edge. Mark it hidden if out of frame.

elements.name: hood
elements.label: Hood line
elements.hint: Front to rear along the hood's visible edge; one point at every bend.

elements.name: fender_top
elements.label: Fender top
elements.hint: Front to rear along the front fender's top edge.

elements.name: wheel_arch
elements.label: Front wheel arch
elements.hint: Along the arch opening, front to rear.

elements.name: bumper_front
elements.label: Front face / bumper
elements.hint: Top to bottom down the front-most edge.

elements.name: windscreen
elements.label: Windscreen / A-pillar
elements.hint: From the windscreen's base up the A-pillar to the roof.

elements.name: roofline
elements.label: Roofline
elements.hint: Front to rear along the roof's top edge.

elements.name: door_front_edge
elements.label: Front door, front edge
elements.hint: Top to bottom along the front door's front shut line.

elements.name: door_sill_corner
elements.label: Front door corner at the sill
elements.hint: Where the front door's front edge meets the sill: the cabin does not deform here.

elements.name: sill
elements.label: Sill
elements.hint: Front to rear along the body's lowest edge between the wheels.

elements.name: rear_face
elements.label: Rear face / bumper
elements.hint: Top to bottom down the rear-most edge.

frames.label: origin: rear wheel centre; unit: wheelbase (each source's own before frame)
origin: front door corner at the sill; unit: front wheel radius (each source's own before frame)

measures.label: rear ride height change (roof rear over rear wheel)
check: roofline tilt change (deg, + rear up)
check: sill tilt change (deg, + rear up)
check: cabin and rear pitch from the fit (deg, + rear up; Rubble only)
